$comment: City of Zürich (BFS-Nr 261, canton ZH) — the oerebdocs docid -> BZO regime CROSSWALK.
This resolves WHICH of the two parallel BZO regimes (BZO 91/99 vs BZO 2016) governs a live
parcel, which the resolver otherwise refuses as 'regime-ambiguous'. The regime is soundness-
critical because the two regimes DISAGREE on the W2bIII max Gebaeudehoehe (8.5 m under 91/99 vs
9.0 m under 2016), so a guessed regime is a fabricated height (SS CONTEXT-DATA-HONESTY).
HOW THIS WAS SOURCED (probe-first, 2026-07-25, no assumptions):
1. Self-sourced the real docids from the LIVE Stadt-Zürich BZO WFS 'rechtsvorschrift_url' field
(endpoint below), across a broad sample of bzo_zone_v polygons. A single parcel's
rechtsvorschrift_url can carry MULTIPLE '; '-separated getDoc?docid=<N> links (verified in the
raw GML), so the runtime resolver parses ALL docids and resolves only on consensus.
2. Fetched each getDoc?docid=<N> PDF and classified it from its OWN verbatim legal-basis text via
the pure classifyBzoRegimeFromDocText: BZO 91/99 cites the BZO 92 -> BZO 99 festsetzung lineage
(GRB Nr. 1559 vom 23. Oktober 1991; GRB 1815/1816 vom 24. November 1999) or self-labels
'Bau- und Zonenordnung (BZO 91/99)'; BZO 2016 cites the BZO 2016 fassung / a post-2016
'Teilrevision Bau- und Zonenordnung' + Stadtratsbeschluss (STRB) chain. The 'BZO 91/99'
self-label WINS over cross-referenced BZO-2016/STRB mentions (the consolidated 91/99 text
cross-references the 2016 exception for grandfathered parcels — docid 16945).
3. A docid whose document carries NO clear marker (an image-only scan, a non-municipal cantonal
ordinance, or a zone-plan change that restates no lineage) is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED from the
runtime map (see 'excluded' below): the resolver refuses 'regime-ambiguous' for it rather than
guess. Absence here is an honest refusal, never a bug.
This crosswalk does NOT flip CH_FAR_CERTIFIED — it only makes regime RESOLUTION possible. The
density/height compute stays gated OFF behind the repo owner's separate human sign-off (VERIFICATION.md).
Machine parity: ZURICH_BZO_REGIME_BY_DOC in
packages/site-parcel-data/src/providers/chZurichBzoCatalogue.ts (parity-guarded by
chZurichBzoCatalogue.test.ts).
multiDocidNote: A parcel's rechtsvorschrift_url may concatenate several getDoc?docid=<N> links with '; ' (e.g. 'https://oerebdocs.zh.ch/getDoc?docid=573; https://oerebdocs.zh.ch/getDoc?docid=6808'). The resolver requires CONSENSUS: any unclassified docid, or docids resolving to different regimes, => regime-ambiguous.
